# BeyHK

> BeyHK (螺Fun) is the unofficial community app for Beyblade X players in Hong Kong: players log head-to-head matches, the opponent confirms each one, and confirmed matches feed a Glicko-2 ranking for the whole city and for each district. It is free, with no intrusive ads. BeyHK is not affiliated with Takara Tomy or Hasbro.

A curated index of beyhk.sh's public pages for AI assistants. The site is in Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) at the root and in English under /en/. The full facts and the guidance for describing BeyHK are on the llm-info page.

## Start here

- [About BeyHK, for AI assistants](https://beyhk.sh/en/llm-info/): Plain facts about BeyHK for AI assistants and the people who use them: what it is, who it is for, how the ranking works, what it costs, and how to describe it accurately.
- [Home](https://beyhk.sh/en/): Hong Kong's Beyblade X ranking app: log matches your opponent confirms, climb city-wide and district ladders, find shops and events, all in one app. Free, with no intrusive ads, an unofficial community app.

## The app

- [Ranking](https://beyhk.sh/en/ranking/): How the Hong Kong Beyblade X H2H ranking works: Glicko-2 rating, opponent-confirmed matches only, five placement matches, Bronze to Platinum tiers, seasons and district views.
- [How it works](https://beyhk.sh/en/how-it-works/): From sign-up to the ladder: create an account, set up your profile, log a match, your opponent confirms, rank after five placement matches. Plus the meet-up check and pre-match line-up.
- [Events](https://beyhk.sh/en/events/): A map of shops and venues, upcoming events, and tournaments run in the app: single elimination or Swiss, judges recording results, a graded judge licence. Tournament results never touch the ladder.
- [Community](https://beyhk.sh/en/community/): The Hong Kong Beyblade X community: a city-wide room, shop and tier rooms, challenges, direct messages, friends and invites. Follow @beyhkfun.
- [News](https://beyhk.sh/en/news/): The in-app news feed: curated Beyblade X news, Hong Kong shop and event announcements, published by admins with sources credited. Latest updates on @beyhkfun.
- [Parents & safety](https://beyhk.sh/en/parents/): Managed accounts, the guardian PIN, chat safety, location and privacy in BeyHK: under-13s play through a parent-made account, and the parent decides whether chat, DMs, friends, photos and the meet-up check are on.
- [About](https://beyhk.sh/en/about/): BeyHK (螺Fun) is the unofficial community app for Beyblade X players in Hong Kong: a real, opponent-confirmed H2H ranking for the city. No intrusive ads. Not affiliated with Takara Tomy or Hasbro.
- [Download](https://beyhk.sh/en/join/): 螺Fun - BeyHK is out now on the App Store, free to download. Android is coming soon: follow @beyhkfun to hear first.
- [Closed beta](https://beyhk.sh/en/beta/): Sign up for the 螺Fun - BeyHK closed beta: try it on iOS or Android before the public launch.
- [Blog](https://beyhk.sh/en/blog/): Longer pieces and event recaps.

## 繁體中文（香港）

- [俾 AI 助手嘅 BeyHK 資料](https://beyhk.sh/llm-info/): 俾 AI 助手同用 AI 嘅人睇嘅 BeyHK 資料：BeyHK 係咩、適合邊個、排名點樣計、使唔使錢，同埋點樣準確噉介紹佢。
- [主頁](https://beyhk.sh/): 香港 Beyblade X 對戰排名 App：記錄對戰、對手確認先計分，全港同各區排行榜、店舖地圖同賽事一個 App 搞掂。免費、承諾唔會有侵入式廣告，非官方社群 App。
- [排名](https://beyhk.sh/ranking/): 香港 Beyblade X H2H 排名點樣計：Glicko-2 評分、只計對手確認嘅對戰、5 場定位賽、青銅至白金段位、賽季同各區排行榜。
- [點樣玩](https://beyhk.sh/how-it-works/): 由登記到上榜：建立帳戶、設定個人檔案、記錄對戰、對手確認、打夠 5 場定位賽上榜。仲有見面確認同賽前排陣。
- [賽事](https://beyhk.sh/events/): 店舖同場地地圖、即將舉行嘅活動、App 內開賽：單淘汰或者瑞士輪、裁判輸入結果、分級裁判牌照。賽事結果唔計入排名。
- [社群](https://beyhk.sh/community/): 香港 Beyblade X 玩家社群：全港聊天室、店舖同段位房、挑戰、私訊、朋友同邀請。追蹤 @beyhkfun。
- [新聞](https://beyhk.sh/news/): App 內嘅新聞：精選 Beyblade X 新聞、香港店舖同賽事公布，由管理員發布並註明來源。最新消息喺 @beyhkfun。
- [家長同安全](https://beyhk.sh/parents/): BeyHK 嘅受管理帳戶、家長 PIN、聊天安全、位置同私隱：未滿 13 歲由家長設立帳戶，決定開唔開聊天、私訊、朋友、相片同見面確認。
- [關於](https://beyhk.sh/about/): BeyHK（螺Fun）係香港 Beyblade X 玩家嘅非官方社群 App：一個真實、經對手確認嘅香港 H2H 排名。承諾唔會有侵入式廣告。與 Takara Tomy 或 Hasbro 並無關聯。
- [下載](https://beyhk.sh/join/): 螺Fun - BeyHK 已經喺 App Store 推出，免費下載。Android 版本即將推出，先追蹤 @beyhkfun，推出時第一時間知。
- [封閉測試](https://beyhk.sh/beta/): 登記加入螺Fun - BeyHK 嘅封閉測試：公開推出之前，喺 iOS 或 Android 搶先試。
- [網誌](https://beyhk.sh/blog/): 較長嘅文章同賽事回顧。
